selector.rationale: The patient's history of systemic lupus erythematosus and the presence of erythematous plaques with superficial desquamation in the malar distribution of the face, along with positive antinuclear antibody titer and antidouble-stranded DNA titer, support the diagnosis of Acute Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus.

rejected.label: Stevens-Johnson Syndrome
rejected.why: While the patient has a generalized eruption and bullae, the presence of systemic lupus erythematosus and specific autoantibodies points more towards Acute Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus

rejected.label: Lupus Nephritis
rejected.why: There is no mention of kidney involvement or nephritis in the vignette

rejected.label: Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and biopsy findings do not fully align with Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis
